policy: Approved runtime exceptions override Figma correspondence only in their named scope. New exceptions require explicit design/engineering review; do not broaden an exception by analogy.

entries.decision: Use destructive-readable for destructive text that needs contrast on tinted surfaces. It is not text on a solid destructive button.
entries.retirement: Adopt the semantic alias in Figma and export it; preserve readable contrast in both themes.

entries.decision: Use scrim, a dark neutral with alpha in both themes; foreground is not a scrim token.
entries.retirement: Adopt the scrim alias in Figma and export it.

entries.decision: Use card-foreground on Card surfaces and primary-readable for action-colored navigation text. Preserve readable pairing in both themes.
entries.retirement: Verify current Figma bindings and reconcile evidence without reducing contrast.

entries.decision: SwitchRoot, RadioGroupItem and RadioGroupRoot retain appearance-preview state enums. They are anatomy, not replacement interactive controls; applications use Switch and RadioGroup.
entries.retirement: Engineering review if the anatomy interface is redesigned.

entries.decision: The existing exact-class/exact-metric exceptions are the only permitted off-ramp typography cases. Do not copy them into applications.
entries.retirement: Resolve each associated design decision, then remove its exception; counts remain checked.

entries.decision: Existing component geometry includes internal raw widths and positioning offsets. Applications must reuse these components rather than copy those literals. New layout uses the approved spacing/container rules.
entries.status: scoped internal implementation; not a consumer allowance
entries.retirement: Replace individual dimensions only through reviewed token adoption and visual verification.
